newsitem.title: CHINA: Group forms for Cho Hung $100 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Group forms for Cho Hung $100 mln FRN.

text.p: A syndicate group has formed for Cho Hung Bank's US$100 million floating rate note issue due 1998, bookrunner BA Asia said on Tuesday.
The notes will be issued off the bank's US$2.0 billion global medium-term note programme.
The one-year notes were priced at par to float at 40 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for participants is 52 basis points.
Lead managers, with US$20 million each, are BA Asia and Societe Generale Asia.
Lead managers, with US$10 million each, are Australia New Zealand Banking Group, Bayerische Landesbank's Singapore branch, BZW Asia, Dresdner (South East Asia) and SBC Warburg.
Lead managers, with US$5 million each, are Chase Manhattan Asia and Yamaichi International (Europe).
